title: GoHighLevel
description: Exposes the GoHighLevel (LeadConnector) v2 REST API as agent tools.
Covers contacts, notes, tasks, opportunities, pipelines, conversations, messages,
calendars, appointments, custom fields, custom values, tags, businesses and users.

gohighlevel.privateIntegrationToken.title: Private Integration Token
gohighlevel.privateIntegrationToken.description: Sub-account Private Integration Token (Settings -> Private Integrations), sent as Authorization: Bearer. It starts with pit-. Agency tokens, OAuth access tokens and v1 API keys are not supported: one token reaches exactly one sub-account, so N sub-accounts need N node instances.

gohighlevel.locationId.title: Location ID
gohighlevel.locationId.description: The sub-account (location) this node operates on, from Settings -> Business Profile. The token is opaque, so the location cannot be derived from it. Without this value GoHighLevel answers 403 with a message that blames the token rather than the missing parameter.

gohighlevel.readOnly.title: Read-only mode
gohighlevel.readOnly.description: When enabled, every create, update and delete tool is hidden from the agent rather than merely refused, and the generic request tool only accepts GET. Safe for agents that should only inspect the account.

gohighlevel.toolGroups.title: Tool groups
gohighlevel.toolGroups.description: Which groups of GoHighLevel tools this node publishes to the agent. This node implements 101 tools across 17 groups, far more than an LLM can choose between reliably, so only the listed groups are exposed. Leave this empty for the recommended set: 74 tools across appointments, calendars, contact_notes, contact_tasks, contacts, conversations, custom_fields, messages, opportunities, pipelines and users, which is everything an agent needs to run lead nurture and appointment booking end to end. Use all to publish all 101. Available groups: appointment_notes, appointments, businesses, calendar_groups, calendars, contact_notes, contact_tasks, contacts, conversations, custom_fields, custom_values, location_tags, locations, messages, opportunities, pipelines, users.

gohighlevel.allowRawRequest.title: Allow raw API requests
gohighlevel.allowRawRequest.description: Publishes the generic request tool, which can call any GoHighLevel v2 endpoint by method and path. It uses the same authentication, version header, rate-limit handling and read-only enforcement as the typed tools. Disable to restrict the agent to the typed tools only.
